[[SolSeed]] < [[SolSeedMovement]] < [[ValuesMovement]]

A movement is a [[ValuesMovement]] if it makes assertions about the source of values and what the highest values are.  Most religions are [[ValuesMovement]]s.

The [[SolSeedMovement]] is a [[ValuesMovement]] because it asserts that all value derives from the basic [[ValueJudgement]] that all [[life]] is precious and good.

See also [[SolSeed and Religion]].
